Coordination contract between Cline (frontend) and Taskade AI (content/visual). One author per file per phase.
A1. One author per file per phase. Two writers on one file = silent loss. If a file is not yours, add a Handoff row (Section C) — never edit it.
A2. Risk tiers — T1, T2, T3 (listed next).
T1 = Auth, Identity, Session, Payments, Data integrity → Cline only during a migration phase.
T2 = Feature components that read auth / plan / role → one author per phase, agreed in advance.
T3 = Cosmetic, content, static pages, translations → Taskade AI, freely.

A3. Re-read before writing; verify by re-reading after writing. Non-negotiable: a write can time out mid-edit and leave a half-migrated file with a live caller (this happened in an earlier session and broke the build until repaired).
A4. Handoff, not cross-editing. Format: date · file · exact change · requester · status.

A5. Frozen set during 0.5 (nobody edits without explicit owner approval): every file that imports authStore or authApi, plus src/main.tsx, index.html, all of src/styles/, and all of src/components/ui/ (platform-owned).

A6. Definition of Done per file: re-read verified · no leftover references (retired symbols: authApi, loginFromSession, passwordHash, verifyPassword, generateOtp, cryptoverse_auth_session, cryptoverse_users) · no new type errors · changelog row.
A7. Phase boundary: write a "modified files + verification status" list into Section D before the next phase starts.

A8. Tooling rules: max 3 files per pass; re-read after every pass; the Taskade space has NO shell so grep cannot run in-space (accounting comes from the owner running the B5 script, or from my reading passes, marked unverified until then); if the Taskade tool drops mid-batch, STOP the batch, record it in Section D, wait for the tool, then resume.
A9. Batch 1 made no code changes. Only this document was created.
